data.one_liner: Get package info, check store versions on iOS, and perform in-app updates on Android.
data.what_it_does: Provides utilities to retrieve app and package metadata like app name, package name, version, and build number. It supports fetching iOS store version details and handling Android in-app update flows (flexible and immediate).
use_when: You need to display package information within your Flutter app.
You want to trigger Android in-app updates.
You need to check the Apple App Store version information on iOS.
avoid_when: You need in-app update support for platforms other than Android.
You need automated background updates without user interaction.
strengths: Simplifies getting package information and store version data.
Supports both flexible and immediate Android in-app update flows.
weaknesses: Android in-app updates are restricted to Android mobile devices, tablets, and ChromeOS devices running API level 21 or higher.
Requires proper region code setup for iOS store version lookups.
data.setup_notes: Requires ensuring correct region configuration for iOS store searches and following standard Android setup for in-app updates.
